Oranges In Red Wine Sauce
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, December 12, 2009 - 12:41am

Ingredients




1 cup Dry red wine
1 cup Water
3/4 cup Sugar
1 Cinnamon stick
2 whl cloves
2 slc Lemon
6 lrg Oranges

Preparation

1 Combine and bring to a boil the wine, water, sugar, cinnamon, cloves and lemon slices. 2 Simmer for 3 minutes and keep hot. Peel oranges and reserve skins. 3 Section oranges, discarding fibrous membranes, and drop sections into the hot syrup. Pare away the white part of orange skin and cut rinds into very fine julienne strips. Sprinkle the strips over the orange sections in red wine mixture and chill. Serve in chilled crystal compote dishes.
